summary: A vertical ScrollArea capped at 220px tall containing 20 Lorem ipsum rows inside a glass card.
use: Bounded panels such as activity logs or long option lists that scroll inside a fixed height.
spec: `Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) =>` builds items labelled Item 1 to Item 20: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet
Each row is a `<div class="item">` rendered with `{#each items as item}`
